newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO'S TIIE 28-DAY RATE FALLS TO 19.905 PCT.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO'S TIIE 28-DAY RATE FALLS TO 19.905 PCT.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Thursday, August 7, was fixed at 19.9050 percent, or a fall of 9.50 basis points from 20.00 percent, the rate for August 6, Banco de Mexico said on Wednesday.

The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is revised each working day, and is valid for the day after it is set. The new rate will be published in Thursday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
The weekly revised 91-day TIIE rate rose 7.00 basis points to 20.4700 percent on Wednesday from 20.40 percent the week before.
The 28-day TIIP rate, also revised weekly, meanwhile fell 7.21 basis points to 19.9673 percent on Wednesday from 20.0394 percent the week before.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
